$comment: Ders/kurs içerik katmanı — Ostinato library.json / JabLab library_test.dart desenini uyarlar (M-F-103/108).
Kütüphane -> Hareket sayfası -> Kurs -> Ders (W0-BILGI-MIMARISI §1). Her hareket KENDİ sayfası.
ELLE YAZILAN İDDİA YOKTUR: her lesson'ın açık/kilitli olması bir ÖLÇÜME dayanır ve
tools/validate_library.py bunu mekanik olarak denetler (LLM-denetim değil, aile kuralı).
DÜRÜSTLÜK KURALLARI (validate_library.py):
1. status=coming_soon olan harekette KURS OLAMAZ (sahte kurs listelenmez).
2. Her kursun en az 1 dersi olmak zorunda (boş kurs listelenmez).
3. Ders, katalogda BULUNMAYAN formError'a atıf yapamaz.
4. Her harekette honesty bloku ZORUNLU (measurementContract'ten türer, elle yazılmaz — W0 §3).
5. status=locked olan her ders lockedReason taşımak zorunda; lockedReason EŞİK DEĞERİ değil,
EKSİK ÖLÇÜMÜN adı olmalı.
6. comingSoon maddeleri gerekçesiz olamaz.
--- Gravita'ya ÖZEL iki kural (kopya değil, aynı gerekçenin bu ürüne düşen hâli): ---
7. gradesFormAgainstReference=true olan AÇIK bir ders, `gradedJoints` ile NOTLADIĞI eklemleri
BEYAN etmek ve her birinin provenance.derivedJoints içinde olduğunu göstermek zorunda;
referansın unreliableJoints'indeki bir eklem de notlanamaz. Gerekçe G-050/G-014: taban-bağlı
(floor) tolerans VARYANS-TÜRETİMLİ SAYILMAZ. ⚠️ Kural ilk hâlinde yalnız 'derivedJoints boş mu'
diye soruyordu; squat referansı DELİĞİ gösterdi (G-072): squat'ın varyans-türetimli eklemleri
KOL, notlayacağı eklemler BACAK. 'Bir yerde varyans var', 'NOTLADIĞIM yerde varyans var'ın
yerine geçemez — vekil ölçen kapı sınıfı hata.
8. status=live olan bir harekette engine.precondition.status DERIVED olmak zorunda.
Gerekçe G-043: kimlik ön koşulu yoksa tekrar FSM'i hareketi değil salınımı sayar
(ayakta konuşan birinin dizi de bükülür). ⚠️ Bu kural, `preconditionStatus` beyanının
ÜRÜN tarafındaki İLK tüketicisidir — beşinci canlılık sorusu (G-059).
Ürün dili İngilizce (PRD §7, V1 yalnız `en`); bu $comment iç dokümandır.

movements.blurb: Set your phone down side-on so it can see you from head to heels. We count your reps, time your tempo, and tell you when a rep didn't go deep enough.

measured: Rep count — the engine refuses to count unless your torso is actually horizontal (identity gate, G-043)
Tempo (down/up timing) — measured from the real turnaround point, not from a threshold crossing (G-055)
Elbow range of motion per rep
Whether a rep was too shallow (partial_rom fires on real footage — replay gate, 8/8 rules live)
notMeasured: How your form compares to instructors. We now have an ATTESTED reference from 5 instructors (36 takes) — but not one of the 9 joint tolerances came out of their measured disagreement; all 9 still sit at our default floor. Until that changes we count and time your reps, we do not grade your shape against a reference.

courses.goal: Get honest rep counting and tempo on your push-up, and learn which depth actually counts.

lessons._why_unlocked: Bu dersin dayandığı üç ölçüm de CANLI: (1) kimlik ön koşulu DERIVED ve üründe aktif (torso_angle_from_vertical>=60, G-043 — ayakta el hareketi tekrar SAYILMIYOR, testi var); (2) rep FSM 69/69 test yeşil ve replay kapısında push_up'ın 8 biriminin 8'i GERÇEK veride ateşleniyor, 0 ölü; (3) tempo eşik geçişinden değil gerçek dönüş anından ölçülüyor (G-055) — yani sayım eşiği değişse tempo bozulmuyor. partial_rom İSİMLİ ürün eşiği (110°) ve G-054'ten beri gerçek veride ateşleniyor. Hiçbiri referans toleransına bağlı DEĞİL.

lessons.lockedReason: We can see your body line, but we can't grade it yet. Our instructor reference is now properly attested (5 instructors, 36 takes) — but every one of the 9 joint tolerances still sits at our default floor value, because the instructors' own measured spread came out narrower than that floor. A 'good line' number would come from our default, not from real instructors. We won't score you against that. Rep counting and depth are unaffected and stay open.

comingSoonInThisMovement: Body-line grading (hip sag / pike / head drop / uneven press) — the rules fire correctly on real footage and the reference is now ATTESTED, but no joint tolerance is variance-derived yet (derivedJoints empty; all 9 floor-bound, G-014/G-050), so we show the cue and never a score
Side-dependent cues ("your left arm is...") — the pose model's left/right labels are not trustworthy in this camera setup, so all rules stay side-agnostic (ADR-003 / G-007)
Hand pressure and load — a single camera cannot see either; this is a permanent limit, not a pending measurement

movements.blurb: Squat coaching isn't open yet. We now have an instructor reference, but two things are still missing before we'd grade you — details below, in plain terms.

notMeasured: Nothing is graded yet. Two things are still missing, and each one alone is enough for us to keep this closed.

The engine has no squat identity check. For push-ups we verify your torso is horizontal before counting a rep; the equivalent test for squats hasn't been derived, so nothing would stop a rep being counted while you're just standing and moving (G-043).
The squat error rules have never been run against real footage — there is no replay fixture for this movement, so we have no evidence they fire when they should.

What the reference can and cannot support: it IS attested now (6 instructors, 36 takes, built at our normal tolerance). But the joints a squat actually needs — hip, knee, shin, thigh, torso — are ALL still floor-bound. The only variance-derived joints are the arms (elbow, forearm, shoulder, upper arm), and elbow/forearm are additionally flagged unreliable. Arms are not what a squat is about.

Left/right comparisons are off the table for squats. Measured left-right difference in the reference is 32.3 degrees (for push-ups it is 5.2), so the reference is NOT mirror-agnostic and we will not make any side-specific claim from it (M-F-46 rule 7).
Knee tracking side-to-side (valgus) — needs a front-facing camera. Permanent limit for this setup.
Weight distribution across the foot, force, or load — a single camera cannot see these.

comingSoonInThisMovement: Rep counting and depth — blocked on the identity precondition (engine.precondition.status is 'pending', conditions list empty), because counting reps without an identity check counts limb swing, not squats (G-043)

Depth and torso-angle grading — the reference exists and is attested, but hip/knee/shin/thigh/torso tolerances are all floor-bound (only the arm joints are variance-derived), so a depth or lean score would come from our default rather than from measured instructor spread
Any left-vs-right feedback — the squat reference is not mirror-agnostic (32.3 degrees left-right difference measured), so side-specific judgements are structurally unavailable, not merely pending

Butt wink (lower-back rounding at the bottom) — the lumbar proxy metric carries landmark jitter risk at deep flexion and is marked pendingVerification, so it would not be graded even once the tolerance question is settled
